programme.title: d/f Otters, global warming
programme.desc: Mitzi the otter lives in the Marais-Poitevin natural park, which is famous for its marshy terrain. Despite the fact that her species was on the verge of extinction, Mitzi managed to survive and even have offspring thanks to a program for cleaning up water bodies. But now the life of this female and her cubs is threatened by drastic climate changes. The filmmakers film the daily life of the European otter as they overcome various difficulties, and talk about its relatives who fight crocodiles in the Amazon or survive in the cold waters of the North Pacific Ocean. France

programme.title: d/f Moremi: Kingdom of Hippos
programme.desc: When floods reach the Okavango Delta in Botswana, the hippos return to the Moremi Game Reserve, turning this piece of land into their kingdom. In this unique corner of nature, hippos play a vital role in maintaining the balance of the ecosystem, providing waterways for other animals and keeping many species alive during this difficult period for survival

programme.title: d/f Sharp fangs of Savannah
programme.desc: We will look into the secret life of savannah predators and reveal the secrets of their hunting. You will see how these animals use instincts and strategy to hunt their prey. Not only by strength, but also by intelligence, dexterity and group tactics, predators hunt in the most brutal conditions of the savannah. France

programme.title: d/s Incredible life in Africa (Tenderness in Savannah)
programme.desc: Africa has always amazed us with its lush diversity of flora and fauna. But how do animals use their skills to survive in an environment as complex and challenging as the Savannah? In this documentary project, we explore African animals in greater detail than ever before, exploring which senses—sight, hearing, smell, and others—help them adapt to wild conditions and survive the struggle for resources. France

programme.title: d/f Garajonay. Ancient forest of Europe
programme.desc: Twenty million years ago, the southern part of Europe was covered with endless laurel forests. One of these forests is still located today on the Canary Island of La Gomera. Garajonay National Park is a true paradise where wildlife thrives without human intervention. A variety of animals and birds consider it their home, including those that cannot be found anywhere else - for example, the giant La Gomera lizard or the dark-tailed laurel pigeon. Spain

programme.title: d/s Amazing animals of Australia. 9 p.
programme.desc: Viewers will travel across Australia to see how its inhabitants survive in hot deserts, tropical forests and rocky plains. programme.title: d/s African stories of the cheetah family. 2 s.

programme.desc: I'm Maleika, a cheetah from the Maasai Mara Game Reserve. I want to tell you stories about lions, our rivals. Lions are dangerous, but they also need protection. They used to live everywhere, but now there are about 20 thousand of them left in Africa and a few in India. Spain

programme.title: d/f Wild Australia

programme.title: d/s Race of Life (Run faster than the wind)

programme.title: d/f Australia from a bird's eye view. 2 s.

programme.title: d/s Water World of Komodo Island (Kingdom of Dragons)

programme.title: d/f Giants of Wildlife. 2 s.

programme.title: d/s Wild Italy: top predators (Winged bombardiers of Rome)

programme.title: d/f Alamto – the country of reptiles
